tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.subtitle: Legendary two-handed sword
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.passive.1: Hits set the target ablaze with purple flame for %ss:
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.passive.5: • Smothers normal fire and never stacks with it
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.ability.1: Leap up and drive the sword into the ground:
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.ability.2: • Up to %s damage in a %s block radius
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.ability.3: • Knocks enemies back and applies an empowered Soul Curse for %ss (%s damage/s)
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.ability.4: • The ground around the impact cracks
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.rend.title: ◆ Ability [RMB] — Soul Rend
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.rend.1: Haul the sword over your shoulder (%ss), then cut diagonally:
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.rend.2: • %s damage to everything in the cut
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.rend.3: • Flings creatures away: the less health, the further
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.rend.7: • %ss recovery without attacks after the cut
tooltip.soulless.soul_forged.lore: "Forged from souls that never found rest"
item.soulless.wraithsteel_ingot.desc: Cold metal that whispers in voices not its own
item.soulless.soulflame_core.desc: A knot of purple fire that burns even underwater
item.soulless.ancient_hilt.desc: The hilt of a fallen king's blade. The blade itself is long lost
death.attack.soulless.soul_curse.player: %1$s was consumed by soul fire whilst fighting %2$s
